name: Solberg-Maru ShiftLayer Zip-Cuff Thermal Glove — Pair
description: Fingerless thermal gloves with zip-on full-finger caps that convert them from dexterous work gloves to full cold-weather hand cover in one motion. Slate blue synthetic leather palm with a knit thermal back panel; the zip-on caps are stored rolled at the wrist when not in use. Fits over standard chrome hand augmentation with an elasticated chrome-knuckle gusset.
functionality: Zip-on full-finger caps for cold conversion; chrome-knuckle elasticated gusset for aug fit; caps stow at wrist.
what_it_says: You need your hands free to work but you're not freezing your fingers off waiting for the temperature to make up its mind.
worn_by: data entry workers with chrome hands
story_hooks: The zip caps on the right glove are a different color than the left — a mismatched replacement that suggests the originals were lost in a hurry.
The chrome-gusset spec matches a Vansen AugMount fitting exactly, suggesting these were designed in tandem with someone else's product line.
